{{Short description|Indian food company}} {{more citations needed|date=September 2020}} {{Use dmy dates|date=January 2019}} {{Use Indian English|date=January 2019}} {{Infobox company | name = Kwality Wall's | logo = [[File:Kwality Walls logo.svg|frameless|class=skin-invert]] | type = [[Public company|Public]] [[Subsidiary]] | traded_as = {{NSE|KWIL}}
{{BSE|544622}} | founded = {{start date and age|1956}} | hq_location = [[Mumbai]], [[Maharashtra]], India | industry = [[Food]] | products = Ice creams, Ice Lollies and Sorbets. | key_people = | net_income = | owner = {{Unbulleted list|[[The Magnum Ice Cream Company]] (61.9%)}} | num_employees = | parent = {{ubl|[[Hindustan Unilever Limited]] (1995–2025) |[[The Magnum Ice Cream Company]] (2025–present)}} | website = {{URL|kwalitywalls.in}} }} '''Kwality Wall's''' is an Indian multinational ice cream company. It is majority owned by [[The Magnum Ice Cream Company]], which acquired it from Indian consumer goods company [[Hindustan Unilever]] in 2025.{{Cite web |date=2025-12-05 |title=HUL–Kwality Wall’s Split Explained: Listing Timeline, Valuation, and What It Means for Investors |url=https://www.outlookbusiness.com/corporate/hulkwality-walls-split-explained-listing-timeline-valuation-and-what-it-means-for-investors |access-date=2025-12-14 |website=Outlook Business |language=en}} It is a major producer and distributor of frozen dessert products in [[India]], [[Bangladesh]], [[Bhutan]], [[Brunei]], [[Myanmar]], [[Nepal]], [[Sri Lanka]], [[Thailand]], [[Singapore]] and [[Malaysia]]. In [[Pakistan]] and [[Bangladesh]], it is known simply as "Wall's". ==History== Kwality, the original Indian company, was founded in 1956, and was the first in the region to import machinery for the mass production and sale of ice cream on a commercial scale. In 1995, in view of the growth potential of the frozen confections market, Kwality entered into an agreement with [[Hindustan Unilever]], and has since been known by its current umbrella name. Its name was created out of two previously separate independent companies that Unilever took over: Kwality of [[India]] and [[Wall's (ice cream)|Wall's]] of [[United Kingdom]] that constituted larger ice cream business for [[Unilever]].{{Cite web |title=Kwality Wall's hits Rs 1000 crore mark |url=https://www.telegraphindia.com/business/kwality-walls-hits-rs-1000-crore-mark/cid/1888748 |access-date=2022-10-12 |website=www.telegraphindia.com}} At the same time, other brands acquired by Hindustan Unilever, such as Gaylord-Milkfood, were phased out in favour of promoting the Kwality Wall's brand. This arrangement allows for local production and sale of Wall's products that are popular in its home market, such as the [[Cornetto (ice cream)|Cornetto]] cone, and to create local variations on others, such as the Feast Jaljeera Blast. Kwality Wall's was ranked 464th among India's most trusted brands according to the Brand Trust Report 2012, a study conducted by Trust Research Advisory. In the Brand Trust Report 2013, Kwality Wall's was ranked 632nd among India's most trusted brands and subsequently, according to the Brand Trust Report 2014, Kwality Wall's was ranked 382nd among India's most trusted brands.{{Cite web|url=http://www.trustadvisory.info/allindia_2014.html |title=India's Most Trusted Brands 2014 |publisher=Trust Research Advisory |url-status=dead |archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20150502221904/http://www.trustadvisory.info/allindia_2014.html |archivedate=2015-05-02 }} In August 2013, Kwality Wall's extended to [[Bangladesh]], [[Bhutan]], [[Brunei]] and [[Nepal]]. As part of larger restructuring Unilever divested all of its ice cream business worldwide and created [[The Magnum Ice Cream Company]].{{Cite web |last=Southey |first=Flora |date=2025-07-02 |title=Unilever makes major step towards ice cream demerger |url=https://www.foodnavigator.com/Article/2025/07/02/unilever-the-magnum-ice-cream-company-now-trading/ |access-date=2025-12-14 |website=FoodNavigator.com |language=en}} As part of regional process, [[Hindustan Unilever]] also divested its ice cream business to create Kwality Walls India Limited. In 2026 Kwality Wall's announced they are changing all their Frozen desserts products to real Ice cream.{{Cite web |title=Kwality Wall's Transitions to Milk-Based Ice Cream in India by 2027 |url=https://dairynews.today/global/news/kwality_wall_s_transitions_to_milk_based_ice_cream_in_india_by_2027_6885636.html |access-date=2026-07-12 |website=dairynews.today |language=en}} Under this new structure, Kwality Wall's portfolio is splitting into two clear, distinct categories: '''Real Milk Ice Cream''' for creamy products, and entirely separate categories for '''Ice Lollies''' and '''Sorbets''''''.''' {{Cite web |title=Kwality Wall's Transitions to Milk-Based Ice Cream in India by 2027 |url=https://dairynews.today/global/news/kwality_wall_s_transitions_to_milk_based_ice_cream_in_india_by_2027_6885636.html |access-date=2026-07-12 |website=dairynews.today |language=en}} All milk based Kwality Walls Frozen desserts are being converted to real ice cream by 2027. ==Logo== Logo used for Kwality Wall's was a slight variation from that used by the other [[Heartbrand]] products, in that there are two distinct hearts in the Kwality Wall’s logo (with the inner heart being closed but the outer heart having a gap), rather than a single stroke forming both hearts.{{Cite web |title=Kwality Wall's {{!}} Unilever |url=https://www.hul.co.in/brands/ice-cream/kwality-walls/ |access-date=30 June 2024 |website=Hindustan Unilever Limited}} Heartbrand logo is used on the Kwality Wall's India website,{{Cite web |title=Welcome to Kwality Wall's! {{!}} Kwality Wall's India |url=https://www.kwalitywalls.in/home.html |access-date=30 June 2024 |website=Kwality Wall's India}} but the logo variant is used on products.{{Cite web | title=Divine Chocolate {{!}} Kwality Wall's India | url=https://www.kwalitywalls.in/p/divine-chocolate.html/08901030513374 | archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20231208082422/https://www.kwalitywalls.in/p/divine-chocolate.html/08901030513374 | access-date=2025-11-26 | archive-date=2023-12-08}}{{Cite web | title=Darkly Divine Chocolate Sensation {{!}} Kwality Wall's India | url=https://www.kwalitywalls.in/p/darkly-divine-chocolate-sensation.html/08901030735325 | archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20231208081940/https://www.kwalitywalls.in/p/darkly-divine-chocolate-sensation.html/08901030735325 | access-date=2025-11-26 | archive-date=2023-12-08}} ==See also== * [[List of frozen dessert brands]] ==References== {{Reflist}} ==External links== *[https://www.hul.co.in/brands/food-and-drink/kwality-walls.html Kwality Wall's] at Hindustan Unilever Limited {{Heartbrand}} [[Category:Confectionery companies of India]] [[Category:The Magnum Ice Cream Company]] [[Category:Former Unilever brands]] [[Category:Ice cream brands]] [[Category:Manufacturing companies based in Mumbai]] [[Category:Food and drink companies based in Mumbai]] [[Category:Food and drink companies established in 1956]] [[Category:Brand name frozen desserts]] [[Category:1956 establishments in Bombay State]] [[Category:Companies listed on the National Stock Exchange of India]] [[Category:Companies listed on the Bombay Stock Exchange]] [[Category:2025 mergers and acquisitions]] {{india-company-stub}} {{food-company-stub}}
extract: Kwality Wall's is an Indian multinational ice cream company. It is majority owned by The Magnum Ice Cream Company, which acquired it from Indian consumer goods company Hindustan Unilever in 2025. It is a major producer and distributor of frozen dessert products in India, Bangladesh, Bhutan, Brunei, Myanmar, Nepal, Sri Lanka, Thailand, Singapore and Malaysia. In Pakistan and Bangladesh, it is known simply as "Wall's".
